lane: LEARN (courses, learning, library, reader, school, gym, arcade, coach, rehearse, lab, interpreter, further)

features.name: Courses
features.does: Builds a course from his words: a map of units and lessons with sources, quizzes with how sure he was, flashcards, a streak and a timed exam.
features.note: Offline it shows the copy on the phone; a lesson not yet written needs the brain.

features.name: Course exam
say: Give me the exam on my engines course
features.does: A timed exam with no marks until the end; an open exam can be resumed from another course.

features.name: Learning: words in eight languages
features.does: Daily word cards with spaced review.

features.name: Learning: typing, handwriting, speed reading, memory, maths, spelling, first aid
features.does: Short drills that are scored and kept, with a streak; handwriting is read from a photo on the phone.
features.note: The first handwriting read fetches about 6 MB from Ghosty's own site, said first.

features.name: Learning: four-week plan
features.does: A plan of a few minutes a day, with the day's line in the Brief.
features.note: It is a plan, not a teacher.

features.name: Streaks and progress
features.does: What he practised each day, and his best runs.

features.name: The Library shelf
features.does: His books and documents (PDF, Word, e-books, web pages, photos of pages) with covers, kept on the phone and searchable.

features.name: Ask the library
say: What do my books say about sulphur dioxide?
features.does: Answers from his own books with the passage shown.

features.name: Wikipedia, offline
features.does: A downloadable offline encyclopedia, fetched on his tap on Wi-Fi with the size said.

features.name: Self-study and Fresh today
features.does: Ghosty reads chosen fields on his own and writes notes; today's digest of news notes.
features.note: Offline it says so; the digest needs the brain.

features.name: Nature diary, gadgets, rights and law
say: What are my rights as a tenant?
features.does: Birds, plants and insects he kept from the Lens, his gadget manuals, and plain-English law guides.

features.name: The reader
features.does: Reads any book from where he left off, with chapters, search and page marks; reads aloud and can be talked over.
features.note: What happens when the phone locks mid-reading is not yet checked on his iPhone.

features.name: School: papers sat in full working
features.does: With signal the brain's own model sits real-style papers in full working and they are marked properly; with no signal the phone's brain sits them.
features.note: The catalogue still says 'the brain on your phone sits real exam papers': it should say online in full working, the phone with no signal.

features.name: School: ladder, placement, results, weak spots, nightly report
features.does: Stages from nursery up, a placement test to skip ahead, every paper to spot-check, weak topics and an optional nightly push.

features.name: School: official papers and question banks
features.where: LEARN → SCHOOL → OFFICIAL PAPERS / WRITE THE PAPERS
features.does: Real public papers (SATs, GCSE, A-level) read on the phone and kept private; banks of checked questions for higher stages.
features.note: Higher stages need their banks written first, a little each night.

features.name: School: reading shelf and borrow
features.does: Graded books, a reading check, and borrowing up to two stages ahead once earned.
features.note: The reading check is sat only on the phone's brain.

features.name: School on the free GPU
features.where: LEARN → SCHOOL → SIT ON THE FREE GPU
say: Sit it on the free GPU
features.does: The same brain sits a paper on Kaggle's free computers in about ten minutes.
features.note: Needs his own Kaggle key in SYSTEM → KEYS.

features.name: The Gym
features.does: Ghosty trains himself by playing 22 games and you can play him: tic-tac-toe, Connect 4, checkers, chess, Go, puzzles and reasoning games, with levels and progress.
features.note: The line 'Training on the graphics chip' is only true for the timing test; the long training runs on the processor.

features.name: Rated chess
features.does: Rated games against an engine with your rating, hints and a game check.

features.name: The Arcade
features.does: Real free classics and free levels, fetched once on his tap on Wi-Fi, with pause, saves and best scores; his own studio games under MY GAMES.
features.note: On an iPhone the phone can't tell Wi-Fi from mobile data, so a second tap is his yes.

features.name: The Coach
features.does: A tuner, ten lessons each for guitar, piano and voice, a typing test and a drawing a day.

features.name: Rehearse
say: Help me practise telling my landlord about the damp
features.does: Ghosty plays the other side for three rounds and gives five lines of notes; a talk for a minute gets pace and filler words; KEPT lists rehearsals to reread.

features.name: The Interpreter
say: Help me talk to a French speaker
features.does: Two halves of the screen: each person holds a key and speaks, the other half writes it and says it aloud; translated lines can be heard again or copied; a phrasebook of twelve everyday lines.
features.note: With no signal it translates roughly on the phone; the phrasebook is in English only.

features.name: The Lab
features.where: Jump bar or voice: 'Open the lab'
features.does: Experiments on free public data kept as pages, run again any time, exportable.
features.note: Not on a LEARN or MAKE tab yet: reached by voice or the jump bar only.

features.name: Mind map
features.where: Home: long hold on the orb
say: What do you know about me?
features.does: A map of what Ghosty knows about him and his places.

features.name: Walk
features.does: A walking companion route from his own places.

upward.idea: School that teaches him back: every paper Ghosty sits becomes a worked-solutions booklet he can study, step by step, from the full working
upward.why: Turns Ghosty's exams into his own revision guide for any stage
upward.builds_on: School's online sitting in full working and the paper view

upward.idea: Courses that adapt every day: the next lesson and quiz picked from what he got wrong and what he was 'sure' about but missed
upward.why: A real tutor's pacing instead of a fixed path
upward.builds_on: Courses' confidence marks, flashcards and mastery

upward.idea: Mastery map across everything: one picture of what he knows, from courses, drills, rehearse and reading
upward.why: He sees growth at a glance and where to go next
upward.builds_on: Course mastery, Learning streaks, School weak spots

upward.idea: Library highlights and notes: hold a sentence to highlight, add a note, export all notes for a book
upward.builds_on: The reader's passages, place keeping and search

upward.idea: Reader with a sleep timer, reading speed, and a voice per book
upward.why: Bedtime listening like an audiobook app
upward.builds_on: Reader read-aloud and its voice switch

upward.idea: Public-domain bookstore: browse Project Gutenberg and Standard Ebooks, add a book in one tap on Wi-Fi with the size said
upward.why: Thousands of free classics on his shelf
upward.builds_on: Library import and the Wi-Fi download rule

upward.idea: Interpreter conversation mode with a transcript he chooses to keep, and phrasebooks per country
Interpreter offline language packs, fetched on his tap on Wi-Fi with the size said
upward.why: Good translation with no signal abroad

upward.idea: Gym: show Ghosty's thinking on any move he plays (what he looked at and why)
upward.why: Learn the game from his reasoning
upward.builds_on: Gym search and the move review

upward.idea: Gym: training on the graphics chip for real
upward.why: Faster self-training, and the screen's line becomes true
upward.builds_on: The GPU timing code already in the Gym

upward.idea: Arcade: controller support and save slots per game
Rehearse scored across time: his pace, filler words and concreteness charted session by session
upward.why: Proof he is getting better at talking
upward.builds_on: Rehearse notes and the KEPT list

upward.idea: Coach: hear him play and say which notes were off
upward.why: A music teacher in his pocket

upward.idea: School: the reading check online too, in full working
upward.why: No phone brain needed to borrow books

upward.idea: Lab with charts on every page and a weekly re-run he chooses
upward.why: Public data becomes a living dashboard

sideways.idea: Homework helper: photograph a worksheet and get it marked with what was missed and flashcards for the misses
sideways.why: Uses School's marker on his own work
sideways.builds_on: Lens 'mark my work' and School's marking

sideways.idea: Language course with speaking practice: Rehearse in Spanish, French and others
Driving theory practice from the public Highway Code
Trade and engineering courses (mechanic, electrician basics) from public sources, with numbers marked as first estimates
sideways.why: Learning that pays off in his work

sideways.idea: Book club with Ghosty: after each chapter, three questions and a short chat
sideways.why: Remembers more of what he reads

sideways.idea: Podcast-style summaries of his books, read aloud
Memory palace drills for names and facts he chooses
Debate practice: Ghosty takes the other side of a topic
Puzzle of the day in the Brief (chess, Sudoku, a logic puzzle at his level)
Quiz night: Ghosty hosts a quiz from his own books and courses for friends at the table
sideways.builds_on: Course quizzes and the Interpreter's two-halves screen

sideways.idea: Sign language basics from public resources
Exam timetable planner: revision days in his calendar up to an exam
sideways.builds_on: Learning's four-week plan and the agenda

cross.idea: Lens → Library: point at a book's cover or barcode and add it, or find a public-domain copy
Comic from a course: turn a lesson into a short comic
Game Studio → Arcade and Gym: games he makes are played by Ghosty, who trains on them
Brief: today's lesson, word cards due and puzzle of the day in one line each
Body: a typing or drawing drill counts toward a screen-break and posture reminder
Voice: 'quiz me while I drive', every question and answer spoken, no screen
